title: Chapter 2: Ember Frontiers
intro: The coalition expands into fractured borderlands. Victories now depend on containing infection while consolidating influence in volatile regions.
intro_es: La coalicion se expande por fronteras fracturadas. Las victorias ahora dependen de contener la infeccion mientras consolidas influencia en regiones inestables.
primary_goal: Finish a run with at least 7 controlled regions and crisis at 55 or lower.
primary_goal_es: Termina una partida con al menos 7 regiones controladas y crisis de 55 o menos.
epilogue: You hold the frontiers, but the rival doctrine starts weaponizing migration routes.
